module_summary: Two-state Moore FSM resetting to B: in=0 toggles between A and B, in=1 holds; out decodes state B.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Single-bit A/B state register; toggles when in is 0.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Decoded from state B; module's only output.

groups.name: toggle_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic on in toggles or holds state; out reflects B.
